Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenThermalDutyBalance

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenThermalDutyBalance
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenThermalDutyBalance extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable caller-scenario thermal-duty receipt for a coupled sulfur/nitrogen hydrotreating screen.

The receipt converts caller-supplied sulfur- and nitrogen-removal heat-release factors to process rates and offsets them against a caller-supplied sensible-heating duty. It does not supply reaction enthalpies or calculate process enthalpy.

1.0
